views.markdown: Apple Music lyrics in the Lock Screen date view! (iOS 16.0+)

**Semi-jailbreak users:** inject into the stock iOS Music app for DateLyrics to work. Injecting tweaks into the Apple Music app will cause it to behave as if it is "offline" unless you have an active cellular data connection. This is a strange side effect of injecting tweaks into the Music app.

### Version 2.3
- Major performance overhaul: lower background CPU use and reduced heat
- Reworked lyric timing for smoother syllable progress and seek handling
- New line transitions, including reverse direction when scrubbing backwards
- Smarter long-line handling and live Minimum Scale adjustments
- Optional Musixmatch fallback plus in-app debug log tools

### Version 2.2
- Fixed opacity highlighting when ad-libs were hidden

### Version 2.1
- New **Opacity** syllable highlighting style
- Toggle to split long syllable-supported lyrics
- Ad-libs can now be toggled on/off
- LSDateView appearance now reverted upon pause

### Version 2.0
- Added line-by-line transition animations
- Custom lyric fonts now supported
- Ad-libs now handled properly (?)
- Option to keep previous syllables highlighted
- Live lyric preview added to preference pane
